title: Ru(II)(n(6)-p-cymene) Conjugates Loaded onto Graphene Oxide: An Effective pH-Responsive Anticancer Drug Delivery System.
authors: Akhter, Suffora; Arjmand, Farukh; Pettinari, Claudio; Tabassum, Sartaj
one_liner_zh: 该文研究石墨烯负载钌配合物的pH响应抗癌药物递送系统，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心是药物递送而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟创新。
abstract: Graphene oxide-based nanodrug delivery systems are considered one of the most promising platforms to deliver therapeutic drugs at the target site. In this study, Ru(II)(n6-p-cymene) complexes containing the benzothiazole ligand were covalently anchored on graphene oxide using the ultrasonication method. The nanoconjugates GO-NCD-1 and GO-NCD-2 were characterized by FT-IR, UV-visible, (1)H NMR, TGA, SEM, and TEM techniques, which confirmed the successful loading of both the complexes (NCD 1 and NCD 2) on the carrier with average particle diameter sizes of 17 +/- 6.9 nm and 25 +/- 6.5 nm. In vitro DNA binding studies of the nanoconjugates were carried out by employing various biophysical methods to investigate the binding interaction with the therapeutic target biomolecule and to quantify the intrinsic binding constant values useful to understand their binding affinity. Our results suggest (i) high K(b) and K(sv) values of the graphene-loaded conjugates (ii) effective cleavage of plasmid DNA at a lower concentration of 7.5 microM and 10 microM via an oxidative pathway, and (iii) fast release of NCD 2 at an acidic pH that could have a good impact on the controlled delivery of drug. It was found that 90% of the drug was released in an acidic pH (5.8 pH) environment in 48 h, therefore suggesting pH-responsive behavior of the drug delivery system. Molecular docking, DFT studies, and cytotoxicity activity against three cancer cell lines by SRB assay were also performed.
abstract_zh: 基于氧化石墨烯的纳米药物递送系统被认为是靶向位点递送治疗药物最有前景的平台之一。本研究通过超声法将含苯并噻唑配体的Ru(II)(n6-p-cymene)配合物共价锚定在氧化石墨烯上。通过FT-IR、UV-visible、(1)H NMR、TGA、SEM和TEM技术对纳米偶联物GO-NCD-1和GO-NCD-2进行了表征，确认了两种配合物（NCD 1和NCD 2）成功负载于载体上，平均粒径分别为17 ± 6.9 nm和25 ± 6.5 nm。采用多种生物物理方法对纳米偶联物进行了体外DNA结合研究，以探究其与治疗靶标生物分子的结合相互作用，并量化内在结合常数（K(b)）值，有助于理解其结合亲和力。我们的结果表明：(i) 石墨烯负载偶联物具有较高的K(b)和K(sv)值；(ii) 在7.5 μM和10 μM较低浓度下，通过氧化途径有效切割质粒DNA；(iii) NCD 2在酸性pH下快速释放，这可能对药物的控制递送产生良好影响。研究发现，在酸性pH（5.8 pH）环境中，48小时内释放了90%的药物，因此表明该药物递送系统具有pH响应行为。此外，还进行了分子对接、DFT研究以及通过SRB法对三种癌细胞系的细胞毒性活性评估。
